shared_elements: procession/row of figures moving in one direction
bearded male figures with patterned/fringed garments
animal shown in profile accompanying human figures
horizontal registers/banded organization of the surface
justification: Both are shallow relief friezes of bearded profile human figures processing in a horizontal register, wearing patterned fringed robes and carrying objects, with an animal in profile in the file — a fairly specific shared processional/tribute-bearer scheme, and both organise the surface into stacked bands. The biggest differences in content are A's rosette borders and prominent camel, versus B's block of inscribed sign-rows above the figures and its denser, more ornamented figure with elaborate accoutrements.
